author: Temminck, 1835
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 겨울철새 수천 마리 · 텃새 수천 마리
habitat: 나무 구멍, 건물 지붕과 틈, 돌담 틈(둥지 자리)
summary: 우리나라 전역에서 번식하는 텃새이자 해마다 수만 마리가 지나가는 흔한 나그네새이며, 중부 이남에서는 겨울을 나기도 한다. 나무 구멍, 건물 지붕이나 틈, 돌담 틈, 딱따구리가 쓰던 둥지 등에 둥지를 틀고 3월 하순~7월경에 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 번식기에는 암수가 함께 지내고 그 밖의 때에는 대개 무리를 지으며, 무엇이든 먹는 잡식성이다. 유라시아 대륙 동부와 일본 등지에서 번식한다.

art.subject: White-cheeked Starling (Sturnus cineraceus), adult male, as seen in Korea in spring: head and throat blackish with a slight green gloss and long, narrow willow-leaf-shaped feathers; forehead and sides of the head mixed white and black, forming a variable white patch on the cheeks and ear coverts; upperparts dull grey-brown; breast dark grey-brown, belly paler grey; vent and undertail coverts whitish; a pale whitish band across the rump; wings dark brown with narrow pale edges to the secondaries; tail dark brown with white tips to the outer feathers. Bill orange with a dark tip. Brown iris. Orange legs.
art.pose: perched at the entrance of a tree-hole nest
art.scene: Korean spring countryside: an old tree with a hollow beside a stone wall; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: blackish head with a slight green gloss, black-and-white streaked forehead and cheeks forming a white face patch, grey-brown body, orange bill with a dark tip, brown iris, orange legs
adult in worn summer plumage (June–August), side view: paler and browner overall, head blackish without gloss, white cheek patch still present
art.build: Medium-sized, stocky starling, about 24cm, a little shorter than a Brown-eared Bulbul but heavier, with a short square tail. Bill straight, pointed, about as long as the head, orange with a dark tip. Legs medium length, orange. Wings long and pointed; at rest the wingtips reach near the tail tip. In flight triangular wings, a white band across the rump and white corners to the dark tail. Walks briskly on lawns and fields, often in noisy flocks.
avoid: Do not paint iridescent purple-green plumage with white spots — that is Common Starling (Sturnus vulgaris).
Do not paint a pale grey head with a red bill (Red-billed Starling).
Do not paint a black or yellow bill; it is orange with a dark tip.
Do not paint a long tail; it is short and square.
